summary: Iteration 17 (v0.5.3-Beta) — Backend 15/15 pytest cases PASS after minor test-payload fix. Frontend 100% of targeted iteration-17 UI checks PASS. All new endpoints verified: GET /api/admin/roles returns 8 roles incl. crm with expected perms {users, chat, tickets, messages, feedback, reviews}; POST /api/admin/users creates a crm user; POST /api/admin/users/{email}/reset-password works for crm (200 → {status:'sent', reset_url}) and returns 403 for chat_support; POST /api/admin/users/{email}/change-password works for super_admin (login with new pw succeeds) and 403 for crm; GET /api/auth/reset-password/verify?token=... returns {valid:true,email} for good JWT and 400 for invalid; POST /api/auth/reset-password/apply updates password and subsequent login succeeds; PATCH+GET /api/auth/me/prefs persist {lang:'en'} + {theme_mode:'dark'}; POST /api/admin/users/{email}/notify-updated returns 200 sent; GET /api/admin/virus-scanner/unread returns {count:int}, POST /api/admin/virus-scanner/acknowledge-all returns {acknowledged:int}, subsequent GET returns count 0; GET /api/admin/counters includes virus_scanner (int); PATCH /api/portal/registrations/{id} with {status:'pending', assigned_to:'admin@pearblue.nl'} updates and GET reflects it; GET /api/admin/assignees returns objects with first_name, last_name, profile_picture, role; POST /api/quote accepts and echoes custom_request. Regressions on /api/admin/financials?period=7d, /api/admin/chat/ratings, /api/reviews, /api/portal/registrations, /api/chat all 200. Frontend: /prijslijst calculator opens (pricing-open-calculator), pricing-calc-anders section + pricing-calc-anders-info + pricing-calc-anders-text (textarea) present, pricing-calc-plain-contact confirmed REMOVED. Homepage: floating-review-ticker + floating-review-card + reviews-scroller + reviews-marquee all present. Admin CMS: user-edit-* click opens user-details-modal with user-details-{first-name,last-name,address,postal} inputs. Cybersecurity: cs-virus-unread-badge only rendered when unread>0 (correctly hidden after acknowledge-all).
action_items: OPTIONAL: server.py is now 2497 lines — still exceeds 700-line guideline. Split into routers/{users,auth_reset,virus_scanner,prefs,assignees,portal,financials,chat,brevo,mailboxes}.py.
OPTIONAL: /api/auth/reset-password/apply does not invalidate the JWT after use — a captured token remains usable until the 1-hour exp. Consider single-use tokens (store jti in DB and mark consumed).

OPTIONAL: /api/admin/users/{email}/reset-password ALWAYS returns reset_url in response body — convenient for testing but leaks the reset token to the calling CRM/admin. Consider gating behind a debug flag or only in dev.

OPTIONAL: /api/admin/users/{email}/change-password 'notified' flag depends on RESEND_API_KEY being set; without it the endpoint silently succeeds without emailing. Consider returning notified:false with reason when key missing.
critical_code_review_comments: reset-password endpoint returns the raw reset_url containing the JWT token in the API response — even to CRM callers. This is convenient but effectively bypasses the email step and exposes the token to any user with 'crm' role via response body. Recommend removing reset_url from response (or hiding behind a debug/dev flag).
Password reset tokens are stateless JWTs with 1h exp and no jti/consumed tracking → replayable within window. Not a spec violation, but hardening recommended.

/api/admin/virus-scanner/acknowledge-all uses require_permission('cybersecurity'), but the sidebar counter /api/admin/counters (which exposes virus_scanner count) is behind require_admin — any CMS role sees the badge count even without cybersecurity permission. Consider redacting the field for non-cybersecurity roles.
UserPrefs validation uses pattern regex — good. However PATCH returns 'noop' when both fields are None with 200; consider 400 to make silent failures visible to the client.
